page.overview:
Who is Cas Meijer?

Cas Meijer was the first Magister Patriarch of the Gold Order.

Meijer was born in Westerland and served as a priest in the temple of Handrich, the god of commerce and divine patron of merchants. Yet he was able to perceive things his brother priests were not. What for them were miracles born of their faith, Meijer identified as a logical process, a sequence of steps that would lead to a predictable outcome. Furthermore, he possessed the witchsight and was able to perceive Chamon blowing from the north, infusing the mortal world's metals. Believing himself to be a heretic at a time when the practice of magic was largely illegal in the Empire and fearing the attentions of the witch hunters, Meijer hid his knowledge from his brothers.

When the Great War Against Chaos began in 2301 IC, Cas Meijer renounced the priesthood of Handrich and underwent the tests of the High Elf Archmage Teclis to discover if he was worthy of joining the future Imperial Colleges of Magic. Accepted as a wizard, Meijer fought at the frontline as an Imperial battle wizard and spent the rest of his life teaching others of the wonder he had discovered as the first leader of what became the Gold College.

The highest tower of the Gold College in Altdorf is named after him.
